verdict.rationale: Alloy's homepage claims 'fully auditable agentic automation' for perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks. That suggests built-in AI agents perform compliance tasks on the user's behalf, but it is a single marketing line with no documentation of an assistant users can interact with or hand tasks to. Fraud Signal ML and workflow automation are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of an interactive in-product AI assistant, a description of which tasks can be delegated and how, scope and controls for the agentic automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
